issues.description: StockIngredient quantity getter is named differently across artifacts. The template StockIngredient class defines a method named retrieveQuantity() (template: src/de/tum/cit/ase/StockIngredient.java, lines 36-38), but the template Stock class calls getQuantity() on StockIngredient (template: src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java, calls at lines 37-38 and 48-54). The solution repository and the intended API use getQuantity() (solution: src/de/tum/cit/ase/StockIngredient.java, lines 36-38). The problem statement also requires adding standard getters for private fields (problem_statement.md, line 22). This naming mismatch will cause compilation errors in the provided template and will confuse students about which getter name to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Provide a standard getter named getQuantity() on StockIngredient so callers compile and follow the problem instructions. Concretely: rename retrieveQuantity() to getQuantity(), or add a public getQuantity() method that returns the same field (delegating to retrieveQuantity() if you keep it). Then update or ensure all callers (Stock.add, Stock.take, and any other usages) call getQuantity(). This preserves the pedagogical intent (standard getters) and matches the solution's API.
